summary.text: Jane-Ellen Udouj-Kutchka is the Democratic candidate for the Arkansas House of Representatives, District 51, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Cindy Crawford.
A Fort Smith native and former software developer, she ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Jane-Ellen Udouj-Kutchka was born in Fort Smith, Arkansas, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Arkansas, Fayetteville, in 1990, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she graduated from Fort Smith Northside, spent 27 years as a software developer for Acxiom, and worked at a small business in Van Buren; she is married and she and her husband raised four children in the River Valley.
Udouj-Kutchka ran for District 51 in 2024 and lost to incumbent Cindy Crawford, 31.8 percent to 68.2 percent.
In her 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she listed strong public schools, available health care and transparency in government as her key messages.
She said she is committed to representing everyone in the district regardless of party, and that her approach is to "listen first, be fair, and focus on practical solutions."
